title: Fake Players Tab
description: Simulate active players with full TAB and LuckPerms integration for a more organic server feel.
body:
# FakePlayers Tab

A simple yet powerful Minecraft Paper plugin (1.21.x) that allows you to simulate a more active server by creating fake players.

## Features
- **Add/Remove Fake Players**: Easily manage fake players in-game using commands.
- **TAB List Integration**: Fake players appear in the TAB list, perfectly simulating real players.
- **LuckPerms Integration**: Assign LuckPerms prefixes/groups to fake players to make them indistinguishable from real players.
- **Auto-Join/Leave System**: Automatically connects and disconnects fake players at random intervals, simulating an organic flow of activity.
- **ProtocolLib Support**: Efficiently handles fake player rendering without consuming unnecessary server resources.

## Commands
- `/fp add [player]` - Adds a fake player to the server.
- `/fp remove [player]` - Removes a fake player.
- `/fp list` - Lists all currently connected fake players.
- `/fp connectall` - Connects all configured fake players.
- `/fp disconnectall` - Disconnects all fake players.

**Permission**: `fakeplayers.admin`

## Configuration
All settings can be tweaked in the `config.yml`, including TAB integration formats, default game modes, and the auto-join/leave intervals.

## Requirements
- **Paper** 1.21.x
- **LuckPerms** (Required)
- **ProtocolLib** (Required)
- **TAB** (Optional, but recommended for full integration)
